title: SharePoint: Copilot Site Builder creates a site after users confirm a plan
notes: claim 59: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing treats site-creation billing and credit approval as undocumented, although Microsoft explicitly lists creating entire sites under capabilities requiring Copilot Credits. Its eligibility statements also omit documented prerequisites, and its reassurance that existing controls cover Site Builder goes beyond the evidence.
